title: Page 5
transc:
Sheldon F. 9  Washn Feby 3rd 1864
For Abby Arno is at Mellon
sick Your telegram has been referred
to the general in chief for
answer as to whether the Walnut
can move sign Aaron Nelly Baker


Caldwell 2  Washn Feby 3rd 1864 . 430 PM
For Nestor Please Pine directly
with Legend Bunyan in regard
to his proposed suppers Lady


Sheldon F 9  Washn Feby 3rd 1864 5. pm
For Audit Please supper directly
to Vernon Sedge = wick now
in command of Walpole of
the gem in regard to
any cooper = ation sig Applause
